mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary conditions, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4%, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, which may indicate broader economic slowdowns and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods following a 0.3pp UNRATE increase, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth combined with rising unemployment indicates an economic contraction, which would lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 30% of periods when GDPC1 growth slows and UNRATE rises, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts reflects weakening consumer demand in the housing sector, which may signal broader economic weakness and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 posts positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of periods when HOUST falls below 1100, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation as measured by CPI suggests tighter monetary policy may be forthcoming, leading to increased borrowing costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 35% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 240, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing retail sales growth indicates weakening consumer demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of periods when RSAFS growth is below 0.5% YoY, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: While employment growth (PAYEMS) continues, rising unemployment (UNRATE) suggests labor market imbalances that may lead to economic instability and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 25% of periods when PAYEMS grows but UNRATE rises, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production signals supply-side weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 posts positive 60-day returns in more than 30% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.1% YoY, this hypothesis is rejected.
